subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The games were held to create brotherhood among the warring states. (b) After that the games were held after every four years until 394 AD. (c) But during the world wars the games could not be held. (d) The modern Olympic games were held in 1896. (e) At that time Greece were divided into many city stats which were always at war against each other. (f) The first Olympic Games were held in 776 BC. (g) Initially, it was only for men, but now it is opened for the women too. (h) As it was held in the temple of Mount of Olympic, it was called Olympic games.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
